newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austereo looks for advertising pick-up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austereo looks for advertising pick-up.

text.p: Radio station operator Austereo Ltd said on Thursday it hoped for an increase in advertiser confidence following what it called a challenging half-year to December 31.
Austereo, which operates the Today and Triple M networks, said it increased advertising revenues by 3.4 percent for the half and achieved a dominant share of the 18-39 market.
"The results were also driven by tight management controls and a reduction in interest cost," it said in a statement.
The company earlier announced an 11 percent rise in net profit to A$17.15 million, struck on sales of A$72.2 million.
"The core radio business operated under difficult market conditions, due to falls in advertising industry spending," Austereo said.
Its Malaysian venture was on track for the launch of five FM free-to-air stations by June 1997, but the Austereo-MCM International entertainment joint venture in the U.K. experienced soft trading.
"It has been a challenging half year and we are hopeful of an increase in advertiser confidence for both the radio industry and Austereo," chairman John Kirby said in a statement.
